evidence.text: equipment ACC-PU-151 (asset S1-PU013) reads "ACC-PU-151 AIR COOLED CONDENSER PUMP" on sheet 1

data_requests.item: Motor rated power
where: the blank HP field on the sheet 1 equipment schedule, entry ACC-PU-151
the motor nameplate on ACC-PU-151
maintenance records: motor record card
data_requests.how: Copy stated rated shaft output in original units. Full-load efficiency and representative input/load evidence remain separate requests.

fields.name: HP
fields.where: sheet 1 equipment schedule, entry ACC-PU-151, field HP

data_requests.item: Measured input power or current at normal load
where: site records: approved existing motor input-power and representative load/production records
data_requests.how: Retain representative period, coverage, load timing and measurement basis. Prefer documented input kW; three-phase watts derived from voltage/current also need power factor and phase basis. Current alone is unreliable at low load. No new live measurements are instructed; record unavailable evidence.

data_requests.item: Motor nameplate, rated output and full-load efficiency
where: the motor nameplate on ACC-PU-151
maintenance records: motor record card
data_requests.how: Review identity, rated shaft output in original units, full-load efficiency, rated speed/current and source revision. HP alone cannot settle the efficiency needed by the load calculation. Stated output is not measured electrical input; retain unknown efficiency rather than supplying a default.

questions.decision_rule: Load factor = measured input power divided by (rated output divided by rated efficiency). A motor running well below about 40% of full load is worth a resize question; one oversized slightly is fine.

typical_benefit.wording: "At loads below 40% of full load, motor efficiency begins to decline dramatically." "Slightly oversizing a motor (up to 25%) can actually increase efficiency." No % saving stated.

where: site records: Existing exact-subject boiler/steam-water, heat-source/flue and feedwater duty, installed recovery/route/coverage and source/revision/availability records; retain foreign or uncertain economizer associations explicitly.

a walkdown: Only if existing records cannot settle an applicable question, agree safe additional observations with the responsible engineer; no compulsory new measurement, operating change or retrofit.
data_requests.how: One economizer label anywhere cannot establish installed coverage, suitability or closure for every boiler. Establish relevant actual service and named coverage; known dry furnace/nonwater helper or electric/no-flue service is not this flue/feedwater task, and unknown service remains conditional. A source-labelled steam generator is reviewed for its actual function without inventing a fuel or drum. Acknowledge suitable existing records or nonapplicability before new observations.

data_requests.item: Existing tuned operating, receiving-feedwater and cold-end feasibility basis
where: site records: Existing actual stack temperature/load/hours after appropriate tuning/cleaning, fuel/composition, feedwater/receiving duty, dewpoint/corrosion/material and practical/economic constraints, with matched units/time and source coverage.

a walkdown: Only if existing records cannot settle an applicable question, agree safe additional observations with the responsible engineer; no compulsory new measurement, operating change or retrofit.
data_requests.how: S4 describes reviewing stack operation after tuning to manufacturer specifications, suitable excess air and clean heat-transfer surfaces; design/high stack temperature alone is not a recovery decision. Review fuel, dewpoint/cold-end corrosion and useful receiving duty before considering a remaining opportunity. Its example temperatures, efficiency increments and savings/paybacks are contextual, not universal limits or this site's benefit. Existing suitable operation can be acknowledged without a compulsory thermometer, quote or retrofit.

No global economizer label, high temperature or fuel label alone establishes absence, adequacy or a reason to obtain equipment quotes. Suitable existing coverage or nonapplicability may be acknowledged; unknown basis remains a records question with no operating or hardware authorization.

typical_benefit.wording: Efficiency "can be increased by 1% for every 40°F reduction in flue gas temperature." An economizer "can often reduce fuel requirements by 5% to 10% and pay for itself in less than 2 years."
